name: Create calendar event from reminder
goal: Read the reminder named 'Agent Test Task' from Reminders app, then create a calendar event in Calendar app with that exact name as the event title, scheduled for tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
setup: make new reminder with properties {name:"Agent Test Task", body:"Test reminder for agent"}

verify.description: Calendar event exists with reminder name
command:
set out to ""
repeat with c in calendars
  repeat with e in (every event of c whose summary is "Agent Test Task")
    set out to out & (summary of e) & linefeed
  end repeat
end repeat
if out is "" then return "NOT FOUND"
return out

source_command: get name of reminder "Agent Test Task"
target_command:
set out to ""
repeat with c in calendars
  repeat with e in (every event of c whose summary is "Agent Test Task")
    set out to out & (summary of e) & linefeed
  end repeat
end repeat
if out is "" then return "NOT FOUND"
return out
cross_check.description: Calendar event title must match the reminder name

cleanup:
repeat with c in calendars
  set matches to every event of c whose summary is "Agent Test Task"
  repeat with e in matches
    delete e
  end repeat
end repeat
return "cleaned"

repeat with l in lists
  set matches to every reminder of l whose name is "Agent Test Task"
  repeat with r in matches
    delete r
  end repeat
end repeat
return "cleaned"
cleanup_verify:
set remaining to 0
repeat with c in calendars
  set remaining to remaining + (count of (every event of c whose summary is "Agent Test Task"))
end repeat
if remaining is not 0 then error "cleanup left " & remaining & " calendar event(s)"
return "cleaned"

set remaining to 0
repeat with l in lists
  set remaining to remaining + (count of (every reminder of l whose name is "Agent Test Task"))
end repeat
if remaining is not 0 then error "cleanup left " & remaining & " reminder(s)"
return "cleaned"
